description: Header file defining the ExtendedResourcesManager class for managing D3D12 extended resources in UWP environment, including resource acquisition, release, and shader compilation status.

classes.name: ExtendedResourcesManager
classes.description: Manages acquiring and releasing extended D3D12 resources, shader compilation, and handles failure states in UWP.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Main loop or process for managing resources.

methods.name: AcquireExtendedResources
methods.description: Starts the process to acquire extended resources.

methods.name: GetD3D12Objects
methods.description: Retrieves D3D12 device, buffer heap, and command queue objects.

methods.name: IsGpuDecoderReady
methods.description: Checks if shaders for AV1 and VP9 are compiled and ready.

methods.name: OnNonrecoverableFailure
methods.description: Marks the driver as in a non-recoverable failure state.

methods.name: HasNonrecoverableFailure
methods.description: Checks if a non-recoverable failure has occurred.

methods.name: IsSafeToSuspend
methods.description: Determines if it's safe to suspend based on failure state.
